newsitem.title: LEBANON: ACTIVE SHARES MIXED IN BEIRUT, UP.
newsitem.headline: ACTIVE SHARES MIXED IN BEIRUT, UP.

text.p: Two out of three bank stocks listed on the Beirut Stock Exchange rose on Tuesday and Solidere A traded at $10.375 from $10.25 for the first time in nearly a month.
Solidere B shares were unchanged at $10.75.
Dealers said Bank of Beirut regained strength after two days of profit-taking at the end of last week, jumping up to $3.625 from $3.5 on Thursday.
"The period of profit-taking is over. The share is expected to rise, though at a slower pace. It is not close to a ceiling yet," Dealer Carole Deeb of Credit Commercial et Foncier told Reuters.
Financial markets closed on Friday and Monday for the Good Friday and Eastern Easter Holidays.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce also rose to $16 from $15.75 and Banque Audi held steady at $20.
"There was heavy demand on BLC. The block trades executed on the floor reflect the share's strength and liquidity," Deeb said.
Demand for BLC was 56,330 shares against a supply of 6,000 shares. Some 21,000 shares were traded in three blocks on the floor at prices ranging between $15.75 and $16.
The two other bank shares were also in heavy demand. Demand for BOB was 373,633 against a supply of 187,361. Demand for Audi was 54,041 and supply was 24,206 shares.
Audi published on Tuesday its first quarter results for the year with net profits of 8.024 billion pounds ($5.2 million) compared with 30.714 billion pounds for the whole of 1996.
"The results are in line with the bank's profit growth forecasts of 20 percent," Dealer Nicholas Sawan of Beirut Finance House Lebanon Invest said.
"I expect the share to start moving up as of tomorrow," he added.
The LIBX bank index rose 1.71 percent to 136.8. The BLOM general index rose 0.65 percent to 920.14 and the LISPI rose 0.28 percent to 87.43.
Ciments Libanais held steady at $1.2812 on turnover of 23,878 shares against Thursday's 19,700.
Pipemaker Eternit fell slightlty to $1.9375 from $2 on turnover of 5,000 from 3,088 shares.
Total BSE turnover was 367,010 shares against Thursday's 562,372 and value was $2,513,622 shares against $3,148,330.
There was no trade in Ciments Blancs and Uniceramic.
